name: Advanced Contact Button
author: WPEnjoy

sections.description:
Advanced Contact Button is a powerful WordPress plugin that adds beautiful floating contact buttons to your website. It includes Call, Email, WhatsApp, and WeChat buttons that can be customized to match your needs.

Features

  • Four contact buttons: Call, Email, WhatsApp, and WeChat
  • Customizable button positions (Right Bottom, Right Middle)
  • Two display styles: Icon Only or Icon with Text
  • Individual enable/disable options for each button
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive design
  • WeChat QR code display on hover
  • Easy to configure through WordPress dashboard
  • Clean and modern design
  • Lightweight and fast

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > Advanced Contact Button
  3. Configure your contact information and preferences
  4. Save changes and view your website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/advanced-contact-button directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings > Advanced Contact Button screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Can I customize the position of the buttons?

Yes, you can choose between Right Bottom and Right Middle positions.

Can I display text along with the icons?

Yes, you can choose between Icon Only and Icon with Text display styles.

Can I enable/disable individual buttons?

Yes, each button (Call, Email, WhatsApp, WeChat) can be individually enabled or disabled.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works well on all devices.
